# Owner settings

<!-- Generated by `node tooling/scripts/owner-settings.mjs`. Edit the code or `tooling/profiles/test-owner-values/<service>.json`, then rerun. -->

Every value below is blank on purpose until the owners publish it. A blank one refuses with a typed `_unset` code and the room shows the refusal (AGENTS.md, product law). Nothing here is a product default. This file does not hold real values; it names what is missing.

180 env settings, 241 owner values read elsewhere, 220 page sizes the caller sends. 585 distinct `_unset` codes in all.

## TEST profile

`tooling/profiles/test-owner-values/` (one file per service) holds 91 values labelled **TEST**. A rig (CX-8, the local test stack) loads them so a fund, trade and withdraw journey runs. `node tooling/scripts/owner-settings.mjs --profile` prints them as exports and refuses unless `APP_ENV` is `dev` or `test`. They are never a product default and never reach a real environment.
